title: Add HDR10 output metadata publish gate
summary: Adds fail-closed HDR10 output verification for bit depth, PQ/BT.2020 tags, topology, and source mastering/CLL data when present.
reason: Prevent publication of static-HDR outputs with silent metadata loss or ambiguous signalling.
rollback_plan: Revert only after replacing the gate with an equivalently fail-closed verifier; never bypass verification before publish.
notes: Fail-closed HDR10 output metadata publish gate.
